resources.string: The app opens the ASN Manager page of your router and signs in for you. Use the address you type in the browser for the router, e.g. http://192.168.1.1 or https://192.168.1.1:8443. From outside your home only through a VPN (e.g. the WireGuard server of the router) - do not open the router page to the internet.
Sign out when leaving the app
The router allows one administrator at a time. Signing out frees the router page for your PC again.
Please enter an address starting with http:// or https://
The password is stored encrypted on this phone only.
Looking for the ASN Manager page…
The ASN Manager page was not found on the router. Is the WebUI installed (SSH menu, WebUI)?
Sign-in failed. Check user name and password - or another administrator is signed in (the router allows one at a time).

The router uses its own certificate (normal for routers). Trust it?

SHA-256:
%1$s

The app remembers it and warns you if it ever changes.

WARNING: the certificate of the router has changed!

New SHA-256:
%1$s

If you did not renew it yourself (e.g. after a reset), do not continue.
